ns2:course.label: Introduction to Latin America
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary introduction to the ways of life of Latin American peoples, their origins and current expressions; discusses social, economic issues, and domestic and international policies related to them in the context of other societies in developing countries.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Non-Western Cultures, and Social Sciences course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
